acceptanceCriteria: complete-manual on a ticket with an unsatisfied COMPLETED-obligation dependency commits and emits a warning naming each unsatisfied dependency and its status.
No warning when every dependency is satisfied; the receipt/mutation contract is otherwise unchanged and the warning is deterministic (dependencies in canonical order).
A maintained test covers both cases; the governing Tasks spec records the requirement.
body:
Owner decision 2026-10-07 (V1-0978): complete-manual should warn when the target ticket has a dependency with obligation COMPLETED whose ticket is not COMPLETED. The completion still commits (the manual disposition may override); the warning makes the override visible.

Reproduction: in the corvint queue, V1-0015 (dependency: V1-0014, obligation COMPLETED) was completed by complete-manual on 2026-09-23 while V1-0014 was OPEN, and no warning was emitted. Synthetic: create ticket A (OPEN), create B depending on A with obligation COMPLETED, then run `corvint-tasks ticket complete-manual --target B ...`. Expected: outcome OK plus a warning naming A and its status. Actual: outcome OK with only the actor-binding warning.

Versions: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360). Likely code: internal/tasks/mutation/ (COMPLETE_MANUAL apply/verified) and internal/tasks/cli/mutate.go.
